title: Arcadia Homes — QBR Storyline (draft)
body:
Purpose:
- One-pager storyline for the upcoming Arcadia Homes QBR (60 min exec + breakout). Draft for review by Prod/SE before we finalize slides.

High-level objective:
- Reaffirm value (latency/cost/wins), surface risk items ahead of renewal, and secure verbal commitment to 12-month Dedicated capacity + SSO & increased retention SLA.

Attendees (target):
- Arcadia: CTO (Sonal Mehta), Head of Data (Liam Ortega), Product Lead (Nadia Khan)
- Redwood: Maya Patel (CS Lead), Diego Ramos (Solutions Eng), Priya Nair (Customer Success Manager), Evan Chu (SRE/ops SME)

Agenda (60 min)
- 0–5 min: Opening + goals (Maya) — set expectations, ask for confirm on agenda items
- 5–18 min: Partnership health & topline outcomes (Diego) — 3 wins + 2 risk signals
- 18–30 min: Operational metrics deep dive (Evan) — latency, error rate, cost per 1k tokens, uptime for last 90 days
- 30–42 min: Product roadmap and alignment (Priya) — features that reduce cost/latency + timeline for SSO/KMS
- 42–52 min: Renewal & pricing proposal (Maya) — dedicated capacity option, commitment ask, incentives
- 52–60 min: Ask, next steps, Q&A (All)

Slide-by-slide speaking notes (draft)
Slide 1: Title + meeting objectives
- "Thanks for taking time. Today we’ll quickly align on value, risks, and a clear path for the coming year. Our ask will be a dedicated capacity commitment to lock in pricing and latency SLOs."
- Note: keep this short, tie to Arcadia’s Q4 roadmap (feature X).

Slide 2: Partnership snapshot (one metric slide)
- Topline: 3.2B tokens served since onboarding; 23% token growth QoQ
- Business impact: 45% faster triage for customer support workflows (internal stat reported by Arcadia)
- Speaking note: highlight correlation between faster inference and CS ticket closure time — bring up their CS-analytics card.

Slide 3: Top 3 wins (customer stories)
- Win A: Reduced median latency from 420ms to 180ms after quantized model rollout (Oct) — Diego to mention kernel/compilation change
- Win B: 2.1x throughput improvement during Black Friday pilot with dynamic batching
- Win C: Saved ~$23k in monthly token spend after cache policy adjustments
- Note: call out the two public PRs where Arcadia provided feedback (nice customer reference).

Slide 4: Health & risk indicators (the honest part)
- Adoption risk: Usage plateau in marketing team (down 12% last month) — cause: prompt drift and team headcount changes
- Operational risk: 3 elevated error spikes in Sept (JIRA-ENG-9843) — mitigated but we asked for root-cause review
- Contract risk: Renewal decision timeline compressed to 6 weeks vs 8 weeks expected
- Speaking note: be explicit about mitigation plan and ask for stakeholder time to execute prompt rehab workshop.

Slide 5: Operational deep dive (metrics table)
- 90d avg P95 latency: 210ms (region us-west)
- 90d error rate: 0.8% (spikes to 4.2% during Sept incident)
- Cost per 1k tokens (combined gen+embedding): $1.18 -> goal $0.95 with Dedicated + quantization
- KV cache hit rate: 18% (opportunity!)
- Note: Evan to call out SLO targets and backlog items: persistent tail latency on long-context prompts.

Slide 6: Product alignment (roadmap & asks)
- Q1: SSO + SAML + KMS integration (security win for Arcadia compliance)
- Q2: Enhanced prefix cache tuning + workload-specific quantization profiles (cost targets)
- Ask: prioritize Arcadia as a canary customer for on-prem private runtime in APAC region (they have latency-sensitive buyer).

Slide 7: Renewal proposal (clear, simple)
- Option A: 12-month Dedicated pool — promised baseline throughput (X tokens/sec), guaranteed P95 <250ms, 10% committed discount, 60-day rollout credit if we underdeliver
- Option B: 6-month bridge + re-eval — smaller discount, no SLA credit
- Our recommendation: Option A with SSO + 12mo billing cadence to hit $0.95/1k token target
- Pricing note: include conditional 3% CRO uplift if they sign before quarter end.

Slide 8: Commercial ask + negotiation playbook (internal cues)
- Primary ask: verbal commitment to Option A in this QBR meeting, signed PO within 30 days
- Concessions we can offer: 2 months free for onboarding of SSO/KMS, professional services credit ($15k) for prompt rework workshop
- Red lines: cannot reduce SLA below 250ms or further reduce committed token price below baseline discount without exec approval

Slide 9: Implementation timeline & owners
- Week 0–2: legal + procurement kickoff (Arcadia legal: Samir Patel)
- Week 3–6: Dedicated capacity provisioning + validation (Redwood ops: Evan)
- Week 6–10: SSO/KMS setup, PS-led prompt workshop (Priya + Diego)
- Success metrics at 30/60/90d: P95 latency, monthly token spend, CS ticket closure time

Slide 10: Open items / decisions we need today
- Confirm stakeholder for procurement (who signs PO)
- Confirm whether Arcadia wants SSO + KMS in initial commit or later
- Time window for PS prompt rehab workshop (2 half-days in Jan)

Appendix: Supporting evidence & backup slides
- Ticket list: CS-302 (ongoing prompt drift), JIRA-ENG-9843 (Sept spike RCA), CS-459 (embed quality issue resolved)
- Live demo prep notes: keep 2 short prompts showing latency improvement (one marketing prompt, one CS prompt) — Diego.

Notes to self (rough):
- Avoid overloading execs with raw telemetry; stick to 3 numbers that matter: latency, cost delta, business outcome (support TTR)
- Have one slide with a simple before/after visual for latency and cost — make it visual
- Prepare a short script for the CTO: "we're asking for dedicated capacity because it eliminates noisy neighbor risk and guarantees predictable latency for X and Y features"

Risks & mitigation (internal checklist):
- If procurement timeline slips >30 days -> push for interim 3-month bridge credit
- If Arcadia pushes back on price -> emphasize PS credits + success-based clause (credit if SLA missed)
- If usage unexpectedly spikes -> auto-burst policy we can enable for 2 weeks while we scale capacity (cost pass-through clearly explained)

Action items before finalizing slides:
- Diego: produce 2 before/after latency charts (due 11/22)
- Evan: confirm Dedicated baseline throughput numbers from ops team (due 11/20)
- Priya: draft the PO template and SSO onboarding checklist (due 11/25)
- Maya: finalize executive ask language and run dry-run with Diego (w/c 11/27)

Version notes:
- v1 (this doc): high-level storyline, rough metrics.
- v2: include finalized charts, quotes from Arcadia users, and legal draft for PO.

End.
